name: pedrorozas
description: Claude Code plugins by Pedro Rozas

plugins.name: git-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude Code from committing, pushing or opening PRs unless you grant a counted, expiring permission, and checks commit messages

plugins.name: agent-board
plugins.description: Live board of your Claude Code sessions, their subagents, activity and token usage

plugins.name: orphans
plugins.description: Finds the processes Claude left running, asks the session whether it still needs them, and ends them when the session ends
